d:
Divali ki agli subah Lucknow ke para ilake men aagra-lakhnaoo eksapresve ke jiro point ke pas bhishan sarak hadsa huaa. Rajasthan ke Bhiwani se Bihar ke Chhapra ja rahi yatriyon se bhari bas bekabu hokar gahri khaee men palat gaee.
Hadse ke bad pulis ki janch men draivar ko lekar chaunkane vali jankari samne aaee. aakhir bas kaise bekabu huee? draivar ki kya sachchaee samne aaee aur is hadse ke pichhe vajah kya thi? dekhie is dardanak sarak hadse ki puri kahani.
